units: <cite ref="Zevachim 34a">Zeb. 34ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 14b:15">Macc. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>נְטִילַת נשמה</he> death penalty. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ <he>נ׳ נשמה</he> taking life (destroying vitality); Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:5">Meg. II, 5</cite> <he>נטילת לולב</he> taking up the festive wreath.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>נטילת ראש</he> lifting up the head (with the ambiguous meaning of ‘taking off the head’ or ‘promotion’).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17">Lev. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:9">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נטילת רשות</he>, v. <cite ref="T01079"><he>רָשׁוּת</he></cite>.—Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ top, a. e. <he>נטילת צפורנים</he> cutting the nails; a. fr.

senses.gloss: נטילת ידים, or נ׳ washing the hands before and after meals &c.
